summary: Remove the Sample age row from the VM usage panel. Host freshness remains on the panel heading; observed_at stays on the API. API impact: none; no endpoint or field changed.

guide.reason: VM usage instructions no longer tell operators to check Sample age; they use the fresh/stale badge instead.

api.reason: API impact: none. The UI stopped rendering usage.observed_at; GET /api/v1/vms and Core observation fields are unchanged. docs/API.md only drops the UI sample-age wording.

roadmap.reason: Public roadmap milestone lists VM usage among built items; living plans no longer claim a Sample age row.

state.reason: No durable state. Usage remains ephemeral host observation; the Controller still does not store it.

verification.method: npm --prefix web run test, python3 scripts/check_docs.py --all, and python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_repository_privacy.py'. Unit coverage asserts Sample age and Sampled wording are absent. Slice accepted 2026-09-16.
